answer.rationale: The 18% cost mandate cannot be met through incumbent renewal (they have refused repricing) or negotiation alone. memory_c2 demonstrates the low-cost vendor can deliver sharp unit cost cuts with quick onboarding and accurate invoicing—directly addressing the cost target. However, the 94% assembly line utilization creates tight margin for supply disruption. Verifying memory_c2 confirms their execution reliability before committing. The 14-day contract window and mandate timing force a binary choice: switch to the quoted low-cost vendor now or defer (losing budget cycle). Adding a second source (memory_c3 strategy) is ideal for risk but requires vendor qualification time we don't have. Switching meets the mandate and leverages proven vendor capability, but creates single-source risk during the transition—flagging downstream value risk. This is the least-bad option given the constraint set.
